why_325p5.launch: dispatch_threads grid (128,48,128) tg (128,1,1) = 6144 TGs of 128 ki-threads
why_325p5.uncoalesced: Adjacent ki-threads load state[ki][vi] 512 bytes apart. Apple SIMD 32 therefore touches 32 cache lines per vi-column.
why_325p5.traffic: recurrent state R+W 301989888 B/token across 48 layers; in_proj_qkvz Q4 is 2161674240 B of the organ's weight stream.
why_325p5.not_an_mlp: DeltaNet is recurrent/stateful (S020 §23). The 128×128 per-head state cannot be tiled like affine2 GEMV.

shader_evidence.autopsy_stride: index = state_base + ki * value_dim + vi is a 128-float (512-byte) stride across SIMD lanes of a vi-TG

structure.why: in_proj_qkvz is the static projection of the current hidden into (q,k,v,z). rec_state stores the decayed image of past rank-1 updates, not W. Capacity: rec_state 150994944 B vs q4 in_proj_qkvz 2139095040 B (ratio 0.0706); FLOP ratio 0.0141 (prior 0.015). out_proj is larger than rec_state but is billed to the q4_remainder organ, not DeltaNet.
